question: How can the completed public cell and spatial measurements be displayed clearly beside their remaining biological interpretation limits?
decision: Replace only the crowded explanatory rationale rendering with a legible source-bound panel; preserve old image and all numerical analyses.
strongest_rival: A crowded or causal-looking diagram could conflate measured RNA, candidate selection and untested functional receptor signaling.
discriminator: Explicit measured-source values, separate alternative-explanation and untested-functional-hypothesis boxes, plus programmatic text bounds and visual review.
exposure_record: All cell and spatial outputs are exposed and fixed. Original rationale image inspected and found crowded. This is only a rendering correction; no data selection, model or biological endpoint changes.
biological_unit: Previously summarized patients: original12 A12 pairs and primary10 spatial AAH/LUAD pairs.
nesting_and_overlap: Existing frozen summaries preserve nested cells, spots and sections. Both branches reuse the Peng/C3 source lineage; the figure is not additional evidence or replication.
population_and_selection: Display existing fixed primary summary rows only. No new subset, score search, gene change or independent-state claim.
contrast: Display already completed LUAD-normal cell and LUAD-AAH spatial comparisons, with existing depth/composition sensitivities.
endpoint: Legible explanatory measured-value panel with exact displayed scalar table and no new biological measurement.
methods: Read frozen primary summary tables, format six scalar values, draw distinct evidence/alternative/hypothesis boxes and dashed reasoning arrows. Assert every title/body bounding box fits its panel.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing/duplicate requested source summary row or text overflow stops rendering. No missing values replaced, no scientific exclusion or threshold changes.
multiplicity: Rendering only; no tests, new estimates, causal edges or acceptance decisions.
precision_basis: Reuse existing descriptive patient summaries and their reported finite-data limitations; no new power or precision claim.
interpretation_limit: RNA detection and spatial cross-products do not establish receptor assembly, functional signaling, validated states, cell contact or independent validation.
stop_rule: Stop for source hash or summary-row mismatch, invalid figure value or any overflowing text; retain previous rendering and unchanged measurements.
amendment_reason: Rendering-only supersession of crowded public_data_rationale image; numerical outputs, source definitions and scientific interpretation boundaries are preserved.
